findings.current: “That’s what you should do. Unless you want to spend the rest of your life exercising restraint in your Inventory.”
findings.defect: The possessive assigns the Inventory to the Skeleton King, but Taekyung is threatening to confine him in Taekyung’s own Inventory.
findings.rationale: The threat depends on Taekyung controlling the Inventory and being able to imprison the Skeleton King there.
findings.replacement: “That’s what you should do. Unless you want to spend the rest of your life lying low in my Inventory.”

findings.current: “Magic Johnson commissioned a grand mage he knows to make it specially, so its performance is top-class. You could name your price for it.”
findings.defect: “You could name your price” means the owner or buyer can choose the price, whereas 부르는 게 값 means it would command whatever price the seller demanded.
findings.rationale: The source emphasizes the ring’s extreme market value, which directly causes the Skeleton King to reassess its dignity.
findings.replacement: “Magic Johnson commissioned a grand mage he knows to make it specially, so its performance is top-class. It’s probably worth whatever they ask for it.”
findings.source: “매직 존슨이 친분이 있는 대마도사에게 특별 제작을 부탁한 거라 성능은 최상급. 부르는 게 값일걸.”

findings.current: [Who Is Jin Taekyung? Chairman Shao Yang bows his head on behalf of the Chinese people. The reverent farewell of S-rank Hunters…]
findings.defect: The established name Xiao Yang is incorrectly rendered as Shao Yang.
findings.rationale: 샤오 양 is Xiao Yang; changing the romanization risks presenting an established character as a different person.
findings.replacement: [Who Is Jin Taekyung? Chairman Xiao Yang bows his head on behalf of the Chinese people. The reverent farewell of S-rank Hunters…]
findings.source: [진태경, 그는 누구인가? 중국 국민들을 대표해 고개 숙인 샤오 양 주석. S급 헌터들의 경외 어린 환송…….]

findings.current: The Skeleton King rolled his eyes around in silence before opening his mouth.
findings.defect: “Rolled his eyes” conventionally signals contempt or exasperation, while 뒤룩뒤룩 굴리다 here depicts his eyes darting around uneasily after being threatened.
findings.rationale: The eye movement shows that the threat has rattled him and sets up his face-saving claim that the world is simply not ready for him.
findings.replacement: The Skeleton King’s eyes darted around as he remained silent, but eventually he spoke.
findings.source: 말없이 눈동자를 뒤룩뒤룩 굴리던 스켈레톤 킹이 입을 열었다.

findings.current: That was the Skeleton King’s brief assessment as he watched Team Leader Choi smile contentedly, as though everything had gone according to plan.
findings.defect: The draft makes Team Leader Choi merely something the Skeleton King watches, while the source explicitly includes Choi among the targets of his assessment that the humans are devious.
findings.rationale: 최 팀장을 포함한 establishes that the punchline applies to Choi as well, not only to Taekyung’s sudden political reversal.
findings.replacement: It was a brief assessment that included Team Leader Choi, who was smiling contentedly as though everything had gone according to plan.
findings.source: 모든 것이 계획대로 되었다는 듯, 흐뭇하게 웃고 있는 최 팀장을 포함한 짤막한 소감이었다.

findings.current: “Oh, right. You’re already dead. You looked so real that I got confused for a second.”
findings.defect: The draft adds an explicit statement that the Skeleton King is already dead, which is not spoken in the source and unnecessarily explains the following narration.
findings.rationale: The source only says the disguise was convincing enough to confuse Taekyung; the fact that undead cannot feel pain is supplied by the subsequent narration.
findings.replacement: “Oh, right. It looked so convincing that I got confused for a second.”

findings.current: “Is being handsome not the greatest advantage? I merely used this king’s face as my profile picture, and countless requests to follow me came pouring in from around the world. Heh heh.”
findings.defect: “Requests to follow me” omits 맞팔, which specifically means requests for reciprocal following.
findings.rationale: The mutual-follow detail supports the preceding claim that he and Magic Johnson already follow each other and sharpens the social-media joke.
findings.replacement: “Is being handsome not the greatest advantage? I merely used this king’s face as my profile picture, and countless follow-for-follow requests came pouring in from around the world. Heh heh.”
findings.source: “역시 잘생긴 게 최고 아니겠나. 이 몸의 얼굴을 프로필 사진으로 해 놨을 뿐인데 전 세계에서 무수한 맞팔의 요청이 쏟아지더군. 후후.”

findings.defect: The draft removes the stammer that shows the Skeleton King has been intimidated, and its formal wording weakens the comic capitulation.
findings.rationale: The broken 아 preserves his momentary fear after Taekyung threatens lifelong confinement in the Inventory.

findings.current: The second headache was the problem now.
findings.defect: The sentence is an unnatural tautological calque and does not read as polished English narration.
findings.rationale: The replacement naturally preserves Taekyung’s transition from the resolved Skeleton King problem to his remaining problem.
findings.replacement: Now there was the second headache to deal with…
findings.source: 이제 남은 두 번째 골칫덩이가 문제인데……

summary: The draft contains one critical ownership error, several meaningful fidelity and characterization issues, an established-name error, and localized wording problems.
